snippet.title: Conan Exiles Enhanced - Console Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Conan Exiles Enhanced is coming to PlayStation®5 and Xbox Series X|S in early 2027, bringing an enhanced version of the open-world survival experience to the current generation of consoles.
